title: Machine files
machine_offline: This machine is offline. Reconnect it to browse files.
sensitive_banner: Sensitive file ({reason}). Review carefully before editing, deleting, or downloading.
select_file: Select a file to inspect, edit small UTF-8 text, tail logs, or download.
binary_body: Raw text rendering is refused for binary files ({mime}, {size}). Use streaming download to inspect locally.
edit_disabled_hint: Only non-binary UTF-8 files up to {max} can be edited here.
edit_mixed_eol_hint: Inline editing is disabled for files with mixed line endings (CRLF/LF/CR) to avoid rewriting untouched lines. Download to edit locally.
cas_conflict_body: This file changed on the machine after you opened it. Your draft is preserved and nothing was overwritten.
sensitive_write_warning: High-risk sensitive file ({reason}). Verify every changed line carefully before saving.
sensitive_confirm_checkbox: I understand this affects a sensitive file ({reason}) and want to proceed.
rename_hint: Edit the filename to rename, or change the directory path to move within allowed roots.
delete_dir_note: Safe-delete guardrail: only empty directories can be deleted (non-recursive).
delete_symlink_note: Only the symbolic link will be removed; its target will not be modified.
delete_sensitive_warning: High-risk sensitive target ({reason}). Deleting this file cannot be undone.
upload_cancelled: Upload cancelled and temporary file cleaned up.
upload_too_large: File exceeds the maximum streaming upload size ({max}).
upload_exists_prompt: "{name}" already exists in this directory. Overwrite it?
upload_sensitive_prompt: Uploading sensitive file "{name}" ({reason}). Confirm before uploading.
